name: get_available_family_types
author: hprebar
title: Get available family types
description: Loaded family types (FamilySymbol) plus system types (wall, floor, roof, ceiling, curtain system) in the project. Filter by BuiltInCategory names and/or a partial family or type name. Returns the type ids other create_* tools need.

familyNameFilter.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against family name and type name

limit.description: Maximum types to return (0 = no limit)
